analysis.description: The paper explores new models combining auto-encoders' learned representations, focusing on resynthesizing inputs to fool adversarial discriminators. It delves into interpolating hidden states for semi-supervised learning and demonstrates the impact of these methods on tasks like classification.

type.justification: The paper focuses on experiments and demonstrations of the proposed models in various tasks, utilizing datasets to evaluate accuracy and performance, thus falling under empirical study.
type.quote: We show quantitative and qualitative evidence that such a formulation is an interesting avenue of research.
